description: Expander for ntrvlc that goes immediately to the right of it, adding control over ntrvlc's stacking and a trigger output for each of its four sequences

params.text: Attenuates the voltage a sequence inherits from the sequence before it while ntrvlc is stacking: 1 passes it whole and 0 removes it, which is ntrvlc with stack switched off
When on, each stacked voltage is divided by one plus the weight, which brings the outputs back inside the voltage range chosen on ntrvlc

outputs.text: A 1ms 10V pulse each time this sequence of ntrvlc puts out a new voltage

notes: the lamp is lit while an ntrvlc is found immediately to the left; without one the outputs stay at 0V and the knob and the switch do nothing.
menu: First output as poly — turns the first trigger output into a polyphonic one carrying a channel for every clocked sequence
